jobs.prompt: Generate one production background image for a 2D side-view Yautja-inspired original science-fiction game, landscape 16:9. WARP MODULE 200: AVATAR SYNCHRONIZATION ROOM. Original ship interior, no movie reproduction. Painted realistic game background matching dark bronze ritual alien architecture, sharp carved black stone and burnished bronze ribs, restrained cyan energy strips with very small red rune accents. Camera strictly frontal, same horizontal ground baseline across the entire image; no tilted horizon. Empty room, recessed alcoves on back wall, two side passageways and one clearly open center back alcove where an independent capsule sprite will later be placed. Reserve bottom 30 percent as a broad continuous unobstructed floor across full width, perspective stone-metal floor slabs; no stairs or floor pits. No people, no standing capsule, no portal, no consoles, no freestanding props, no weapons, no text labels or watermark. The alcoves are architectural recesses only. Keep the middle and foreground entirely clear for gameplay movement. A single finished background, not a grid or mood board.

Create one isolated game environment sprite: WARP MODULE 202 DECONTAMINATION AIRLOCK FRAME, for an original Yautja-inspired ritual science fiction spaceship. Full complete upright doorway standing on its own small low threshold, perfectly frontal orthographic side-view game camera, symmetrical dark bronze and charcoal stone-metal carved ribs with restrained thin cyan decontamination lights and tiny dim red rune marks. The frame is thick, practical and industrial, with visible seals, recessed tracks and side filtration canisters built into the jambs. Door is OPEN: the entire large central walking aperture must be completely transparent, no fog, no membrane, no dark rectangular wall, no door leaf, no scene visible through opening. Transparent outer background also. Two shutters are retracted fully inside the side jambs and not across the aperture; the game will render the closing panels separately. All frame extremities and ground-contact feet entirely inside image with a little margin, no cropping. Wide usable central opening, enough clearance for a tall hunter. One sprite only, no contact sheet, no text, no badge or watermark, no cast shadow extending outside the small threshold. Detailed realistic painted game asset, coherent bronze/black palette, readable silhouette at 180 pixels high. This is an original project design, no exact film identity claim.
